tagline: The world's most popular language learning platform
hero_kpi_rationale: Monthly Active Users (MAUs) is a key indicator of Duolingo's platform growth and engagement, reflecting its dominant position in the language learning market.

kpis.name: Monthly Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of unique users who use the Duolingo app or the learning section of the website each month.
kpis.description: Key indicator of platform growth and engagement. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the past 5 years.
kpis.signal: 14% growth compared to the previous year.

kpis.name: Daily Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of unique users who use the Duolingo app or the learning section of the website each day.
kpis.signal: 30% growth compared to the previous year.

kpis.name: Paid Subscribers
kpis.explanation: Number of users paying for premium features (Super Duolingo or Duolingo Max) at the end of the period.
kpis.description: Key indicator of revenue generation and conversion of free users.
kpis.signal: 28% growth compared to the previous year.

kpis.name: Subscription Bookings Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total subscription bookings revenue for the calendar year.
kpis.description: Key indicator of subscription revenue generation.
kpis.signal: 36% growth compared to the previous year.

kpis.name: Net Income

kpis.signal: 367% growth compared to the previous year, supported by a tax provision allocation of $256.7M.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition in the language learning market is high and could impact Duolingo's growth.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a constantly evolving market, with new entrants and technological innovations that could threaten its leading position.

risks.title: Data Dependency
risks.summary: Loss or corruption of data could have serious consequences for the company.
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily relies on user-generated data to improve its product and make business decisions.

risks.title: Regulations
risks.summary: Changes in regulations could force the company to adapt its practices and invest in new technologies to comply.
risks.score_rationale: Data protection and privacy regulations could impact the company's operations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cybersecurity is a major risk for the company, as a security breach could have serious consequences for users and the company itself.
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks could compromise user data and damage the company's reputation.

risks.title: Platform Dependency
risks.summary: Changes in platform policies or terms of use could impact the visibility and accessibility of the Duolingo app.
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily depends on mobile app platforms to distribute its product.

risks.title: Employee-Related Risks
risks.summary: Human resource management is crucial for the company's success, as employees play an essential role in product development and maintenance.
risks.score_rationale: Loss of key personnel or difficulty attracting and retaining talent could impact the company's ability to innovate and grow.

ai_positioning.summary: Duolingo integrates artificial intelligence and machine learning as core components of its educational platform, leveraging massive user engagement data to power sophisticated AI techniques and continuously improve learning engagement and effectiveness.
evidence: Products are powered by sophisticated data analytics and AI
Machine learning is used to improve learning outcomes
Users generate 2 billion exercises per day, fueling high-volume A/B testing and new AI techniques
